trials.subject: N1
trials.reason: Mouseup preserves suppression and #down clears it, but its event binding is absent; the click reaches #activate, whose dispatch depends on suppression.
trials.missing: Verify that the fresh Overview pointer press invokes #down before its click; the supplied fragments omit the mousedown listener registration and target.

causalReview.note: Identifies the absent mousedown binding as the premise needed to connect #down to selection.
